# surfd.toml settings reference

<!-- Generated by tools/gen_settings_doc.py from the schema; do not edit by hand. -->

Every key, its default and what it accepts. Change any of them with
`surfctl set <key> <value>`, in Surf Settings, or by editing
`~/.config/surfd/surfd.toml` and running `surfctl reload`.

## [theme]

| Key | Default | Accepts | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | `"tide"` | text | Theme pack name (a folder in ~/.local/share/surfd/themes or /usr/share/surfd/themes). |
| `variant` | `"dark"` | `dark` \| `light` | Dark or light colours. |
| `accent` | `""` | `""` or `"#rrggbb"` | Accent colour like "#88c0d0"; empty uses the theme's accent. |

## [fonts]

| Key | Default | Accepts | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `ui` | `"Inter"` | text | Interface font family. |
| `mono` | `"JetBrains Mono"` | text | Monospace font family (terminal, code). |
| `size` | `11` | int 6–32 | Interface font size in points. |
| `mono_size` | `11` | int 6–32 | Monospace font size in points. |

## [wallpaper]

| Key | Default | Accepts | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `path` | `""` | text | Your own image file; it wins over the dynamic wallpaper. Empty uses the dynamic wallpaper below, or the theme's wallpaper when that is empty too. |
| `dynamic` | `"low-poly-mountain"` | text | A dynamic wallpaper set that changes with the time of day (a folder in ~/.local/share/surfd/wallpapers/dynamic or /usr/share/surfd/wallpapers/dynamic); empty turns it off. See `surfctl wallpaper list`. |
| `sync` | `"auto"` | `auto` \| `theme` \| `frame` | How the dynamic wallpaper picks its frame. auto: follow the time of day. theme: the lightest frame in the light style, the darkest in the dark style. frame: one fixed frame (see wallpaper.frame). |
| `frame` | `""` | text | With sync = "frame": the frame to show, by number or part of its file name (see `surfctl wallpaper status`). |
| `location` | `""` | text | Where you are, for dynamic wallpapers that follow the sun: "latitude, longitude" such as "35.2, 33.4". Empty guesses from your time zone. |
| `mode` | `"fill"` | `fill` \| `fit` \| `center` \| `tile` \| `stretch` | How the image is scaled. |

## [layout]

| Key | Default | Accepts | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `mode` | `"tiling"` | `tiling` \| `floating` | tiling: windows tile automatically. floating: windows float with title bars (mouse-friendly). |
| `gaps_inner` | `8` | int 0–64 | Space between windows in pixels. |
| `gaps_outer` | `6` | int 0–64 | Space around the screen edge in pixels. |
| `border_width` | `2` | int 0–10 | Window border width in pixels. |
| `radius` | `12` | int 0–32 | Corner rounding for the bar, notifications, launcher and lock screen. (Sway draws square window borders.) |
| `titlebars` | `false` | true / false | Show window title bars in tiling mode (always on in floating mode). |
| `focus_follows_mouse` | `true` | true / false | Focus windows by hovering. |

## [bar]

| Key | Default | Accepts | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `position` | `"top"` | `top` \| `bottom` | Bar at the top or bottom of the screen. |
| `style` | `"floating"` | `floating` \| `docked` | floating: a detached rounded bar. docked: full-width, edge to edge. |
| `height` | `34` | int 20–64 | Bar height in pixels. |
| `left` | `["workspaces", "mode", "window"]` | list of bar modules | Modules on the left. |
| `center` | `["clock"]` | list of bar modules | Modules in the centre. |
| `right` | `["tray", "network", "audio", "battery", "power"]` | list of bar modules | Modules on the right. |

## [input]

| Key | Default | Accepts | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `keyboard_layout` | `"us"` | text | XKB layout(s), e.g. "us" or "us,de". |
| `keyboard_variant` | `""` | text | XKB variant, e.g. "intl" or "". |
| `keyboard_options` | `""` | text | XKB options, e.g. "caps:escape,grp:alt_shift_toggle". |
| `touchpad_tap` | `true` | true / false | Tap to click on touchpads. |
| `natural_scroll` | `true` | true / false | Content follows your fingers on touchpads. |
| `gestures` | `true` | true / false | Three-finger swipes switch workspaces; swipe up opens the launcher. |
| `pointer_accel` | `0.0` | float -1–1 | Pointer speed from -1 (slow) to 1 (fast). |

## [display]

| Key | Default | Accepts | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `scale` | `0.0` | float 0–4 | Output scale for all displays; 0 lets Sway decide. |

## [apps]

| Key | Default | Accepts | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `terminal` | `"foot"` | text | Terminal command. |
| `launcher` | `"fuzzel"` | text | App launcher command (fuzzel by default). |
| `browser` | `"firefox"` | text | Web browser command. |
| `files` | `"thunar"` | text | File manager command. |
| `editor` | `"mousepad"` | text | Text editor command. |

## [idle]

| Key | Default | Accepts | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `lock_after` | `300` | int 0–86400 | Lock the screen after this many idle seconds (0 = never). |
| `screen_off_after` | `600` | int 0–86400 | Turn displays off after this many idle seconds (0 = never). |
| `suspend_after` | `0` | int 0–86400 | Suspend after this many idle seconds (0 = never). |

## [notifications]

| Key | Default | Accepts | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `position` | `"top-right"` | `top-right` \| `top-center` \| `top-left` \| `bottom-right` \| `bottom-center` \| `bottom-left` | Where notifications appear. |
| `timeout` | `6000` | int 0–120000 | Milliseconds before a notification hides (0 = until dismissed). |

## [keys]

| Key | Default | Accepts | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `modifier` | `"Super"` | `Super` \| `Alt` | The main modifier used as "Mod" in key bindings. |

## [autostart]

| Key | Default | Accepts | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `commands` | `[]` | list of strings | Commands started with the session. |

## [keys.bindings]

`"<combo>" = "<action>"`. `Mod` means `keys.modifier`. Set an action to `"none"` to
disable a default binding.

| Action | What it does |
|---|---|
| `terminal` | Open a terminal |
| `launcher` | Search and launch apps |
| `browser` | Open the web browser |
| `files` | Open the file manager |
| `editor` | Open the text editor |
| `settings` | Open Surf Settings |
| `cheatsheet` | Show this cheat sheet |
| `close` | Close the window |
| `fullscreen` | Toggle fullscreen |
| `toggle-floating` | Float / tile the window |
| `focus-mode-toggle` | Switch focus between tiled and floating |
| `layout-toggle` | Cycle layout: split, tabbed, stacked |
| `split-horizontal` | Next window opens to the right |
| `split-vertical` | Next window opens below |
| `focus-parent` | Focus the parent container |
| `resize-mode` | Resize with arrow keys (Esc to finish) |
| `scratchpad` | Show / hide the scratchpad |
| `move-to-scratchpad` | Send the window to the scratchpad |
| `workspace-next` | Next workspace |
| `workspace-prev` | Previous workspace |
| `workspace-last` | Back to the last workspace |
| `lock` | Lock the screen |
| `power-menu` | Log out, suspend, restart, shut down |
| `reload` | Reload the desktop configuration |
| `screenshot` | Screenshot the whole screen |
| `screenshot-area` | Screenshot a selected area |
| `notifications-dismiss` | Dismiss notifications |
| `notifications-restore` | Show the last notification again |
| `volume-up` | Volume up |
| `volume-down` | Volume down |
| `volume-mute` | Mute / unmute |
| `mic-mute` | Mute / unmute microphone |
| `brightness-up` | Brightness up |
| `brightness-down` | Brightness down |
| `media-play` | Play / pause |
| `media-next` | Next track |
| `media-prev` | Previous track |
| `focus left\|right\|up\|down` | Move focus |
| `move left\|right\|up\|down` | Move the window |
| `workspace N` | Go to workspace N |
| `move-to-workspace N` | Send the window to workspace N |
| `exec <command>` | Run a command (no `;` or `,`: use a script) |
| `sway <command>` | Any raw Sway command |

## Bar modules

| Module | Shows |
|---|---|
| `workspaces` | Workspace buttons |
| `mode` | Current Sway mode (e.g. resize) |
| `window` | Focused window title |
| `taskbar` | Open windows (good for floating mode) |
| `clock` | Date and time |
| `tray` | System tray (network, Bluetooth applets) |
| `network` | Wi-Fi / Ethernet status |
| `audio` | Volume (click: mixer) |
| `battery` | Battery level |
| `backlight` | Screen brightness |
| `bluetooth` | Bluetooth status |
| `cpu` | CPU usage |
| `memory` | Memory usage |
| `temperature` | CPU temperature |
| `keyboard` | Keyboard layout |
| `media` | Now playing (MPRIS) |
| `idle` | Keep-awake toggle |
| `power` | Power menu button |
